title: Replace Notion With a Custom Tool Built in an Afternoon
summary: Notion Plus costs $10/user/month — and a 20-person team on Business pays $4,800 a year. Build your own custom knowledge base, project tracker, or wiki in one afternoon instead.
body_markdown: Notion has a strong uptime record. Blink-hosted apps run on production infrastructure with the same reliability expectations. The honest tradeoff: Notion's status page is public and well-known; a custom app's reliability depends on Blink's infrastructure. For internal tools and client portals, this is an acceptable tradeoff for most teams. For mission-critical operations, you'd evaluate both with the same rigor.
